description: `select id, name` is passed to a prop whose contract `Card` also declares `email`. Per §14.8.8 the projection does not satisfy the contract's width, so E-SQL-ROW-CONTRACT-MISMATCH fires (§34: Error) naming the unprojected field. NOTE: the projection must reach the prop DIRECTLY — routing it through a typed cell (`<users>: Card[]`) erases the projection type and the bounded rule no-ops, which is why this case binds `const rows = ?{…}` and iterates it.
rationale: §14.8.8 — when a SQL projection row is passed to a prop carrying a `:struct` contract, the row must satisfy that contract by WIDTH: every field the contract declares must be projected. A missing column is not a runtime `undefined` to be discovered in the UI — the SELECT list is statically known, so the mismatch is decidable at compile time and is reported against the SELECT rather than the render.
